title: ikgpc: reproduction code for 'Reinterpreting Indicator Kriging from a Machine Learning Perspective in the Context of Gaussian Process Classification'
description:
Reproduction package for Li and You (Mathematical Geosciences, revised manuscript). It implements multi-class Gaussian process classification with a softmax link under the Laplace approximation (Rasmussen and Williams 2006, Algorithms 3.3-3.4), simple indicator kriging with shared or per-class indicator covariances, and the numerical checks of the result that indicator kriging is the first-order approximation of softmax GPC. All figures and tables of the paper are regenerated by python scripts/run_all.py.

Development repository: https://github.com/yupenglee2006-ui/ikgpc-reinterpretation.

Generated results (figures, tables, intermediate .npz files) are not included; they are regenerated deterministically by the scripts. The Jura data set (Atteia et al. 1994; Goovaerts 1997) is redistributed unchanged in data/.
